merra2_cell.note: The weather grid cell is ice sheet with no bare land, and can be 5-12 °C colder in summer than the bare-ground site. Temperature, wind chill and usable days describe the ice next to the site and are too pessimistic.

snow_note: MOD10CM maps Antarctica as snow by design, so snow cover is not measured at this site.

sun_samples.time: local mean solar time, minutes after local midnight (UTC + longitude / 15 h)
